title: Research: audit P104 tangent-to-orbit local regularity (no new kappa)
body:
## Status

Independent proof-step audit; no new κ, decoder construction, supplier, or selected-frontier change. This is a second review following the completed claim [#1275](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1275) and [PR #1292](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1292). It does not repeat the tangent-matrix census: it checks the local regularity implication and exhaustively verifies the displayed P104 kernel generators against the pinned reduced systems.

## Finding

For each of the three P104 representatives, the pinned certificate gives tangent dimension 103 at `K0 = 2G`, equal to the dimension of the diagonal-torus orbit `O`. Since `O` is smooth and contained in the masked rank-eight variety `X`, `dim_K0(X) >= 103`; the certified tangent dimension gives `dim(T_K0 X) <= 103`. Thus the local ring is regular and `X` is smooth near `K0`. The inclusion `O -> X` has an isomorphism on tangent spaces between smooth 103-dimensional manifolds, so the inverse function theorem gives equality of their germs.

This supports the stated **local** conclusion. It does not rule out distant off-orbit P104 components or rank-nine costly parts and does not change the selected κ.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -B research/seed38-p104-orbit-regularity-audit/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/seed38-p104-orbit-regularity-audit --check-only
```

The verifier replays the pinned PR #1292 certificate, including its D4⊕D4 negative control and seeded sample, then checks all 168 gauge/torus generators against all 4,992 reduced rows in each of the three P104 classes modulo `2^31 - 1`. It reports tangent/orbit dimension 103. The proof argument is in `PROOF.md`.
